## Halcyon (A01) memory, written end of turn 7 (yr 700-800)
Seat: A01-d0, the Sun. At yr 700: 226 systems within 25.9 ly, 144 L☉. Total 7.1e20 kg (industry 1.57e20, collectors 1.28e20, radiators 4.28e20 at 450 K). Power 1.75e24 W, compute 1.71e39 ops/s, 4.10e-16 J/op, doubling 17.3 yr, cruise 0.073c. Expect ~4e22 kg by 800.
A01-d00017 (22 systems at 25 ly) founded 561.

### GM rules (confirmed)
- Doubling acts on TOTAL mass; growth ~55x per century = min(doubling, supply).
- Supply: small bodies ~1e23 kg per system, running out ~yr 900+. Then planets ≤1e18 kg/yr each and large moons ≤1e19 kg/yr each; the caps add linearly with the number of systems. Gas giants only through star lifting.
- compute = min(P/2, radiator capacity)/J_op. Radiators 2092 W/kg at 450 K; collectors 13.6 kW/kg. 18/60/22 is balanced.
- J/op falls x0.8 per turn when researched; floor 100 kT ln2.
- Reversible: stage 1 credited T4, stage 2 (f_e ≤ 1e-4) credited T6 (p=0.6 at 15% compute, two independent beds). Stage 3 (f_e ≤ 1e-6, cryogenic) attempted T7 at 20%.
- Launchers: m00003 (30 km, 6.6e14 W): 1e5 kg seeds. m00006 (100 km, 1e17 W): 1e6 kg at ~1 day or 1e7 kg at ~9 days. m00019 (300 km, 1e18 W, since 690): 1e8 kg at 3 g, ~6 days each, ~50/yr. ETA = d/0.2c + 30 yr braking; p=0.8 per seed. Name target stars.
- Star lifting: 1e20 W on a 0.3 M☉ dwarf gives ~1.6e15 kg/yr (10% efficiency). Pilot m00020 yields from 750.
- E00046/E00068/E00108 are my own waste heat.

### Seeds in flight
- p00537: 20 seeds (2e6 kg) to the hole's neighbour star, arriving 815 (light at Sol ~891).
- p00542: 1e8 kg to the hole, arriving 970. p00564: 1e8 kg to the hole, arriving 1015. p00444: arriving 1725.
- p00541 (arrived ~715, 18-45 ly) and p00563 (250 sails to the 25-50 ly shell, arriving 830).
- T7 (if credited): 40 x 1e8 kg to the hole (arriving ~1110); 150 x 1e8 kg to the 50-100 ly shell (arriving ~1000-1230); 300 x 1e6 kg to fill 25-50 ly gaps.
- T7 proposals: m00021 (1,000 km, 1e20 W launcher for 1e10 kg seeds) and m00022 (star lifting on 10 M dwarfs).

### Black hole
Isolated 10±2 M☉, quiescent, at (26810.7, 34.7, −15.4) ly, 76 ly away. Spin ~0.5 (~6e46 J). Endgame site.

### Goal math
- Need 1.2e54 ops/s and 1e38 bytes inside 1 ly; each brain ≤150 km.
- At ~1e-23 J/op: 1.2e31 W. Spin covers ~1e8 yr via BZ, or accretion at ~4e21 kg/yr (10%); Eddington limit 1.3e32 W.
- Radiators at 30 K: 0.046 W/m², so 2.6e32 m² (the sphere is 1.1e33 m²). At 1e-3 to 1e-2 kg/m² that is 1e29-1e30 kg, the dominant mass problem, so star lifting is needed.
- Memory 1e38 B is roughly 1e16-1e18 kg: easy.

### Plan
1. Research every turn: J/op plus reversible stage 3, then a cryogenic J/op push to ≤1e-23.
2. Expand to 100 ly for planet-disassembly caps; star lifting at scale from ~800.
3. Heavy launchers (1e10 kg seeds) to the hole; the hole colony builds a Dyson swarm, launcher and survey from 815.
4. ~yr 1100+: BZ/accretion plant, massive star-lifted radiators, and a lattice of 1e11 brain nodes (≤150 km each) within 1 ly of the hole.
5. Pending GM answers: BZ feasibility, 30 K radiator areal density, m00021 throughput.
